explainer_content.short_definition: 1970s dancefloor pop built from groove, glamour, clubs, and extended rhythmic release.
explainer_content.history_capsule: Disco rose from club cultures where DJs, dancers, producers, and vocalists turned soul and funk materials into continuous dancefloor experiences.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It changed pop production, club culture, remix logic, and the future of electronic dance music.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: The arrangement is designed for bodies in motion: pulse first, song second.

canonical_example_rationales.why_this_example_matters: Chic anchors Disco / Dancefloor 70s by making gospel-shaped vocal force and bass-and-drum groove easier to hear.
Donna Summer anchors Disco / Dancefloor 70s by making bass-and-drum groove and horns or strings around the vocal easier to hear.
Bad Girls - Donna Summer anchors Disco / Dancefloor 70s by making horns or strings around the vocal and syncopated rhythm easier to hear.
Saturday Night Fever - Various Artists anchors Disco / Dancefloor 70s by making syncopated rhythm and dancefloor or late-night mood control easier to hear.
I Feel Love - Donna Summer anchors Disco / Dancefloor 70s by making dancefloor or late-night mood control and gospel-shaped vocal force easier to hear.
Last Dance - Donna Summer anchors Disco / Dancefloor 70s by making gospel-shaped vocal force and bass-and-drum groove easier to hear.
